TDPL.description: Tendon Prestress Load (TDPL). Applies prestress jacking loads to tendons under a static load case; each ITEMS entry carries the load case, tendon, value type, jacking order and begin/end magnitudes.

ITEMS.description: List of tendon prestress load entries applied under the given static load case (key = tendon element/entity key).

ID.description: Serial number of this prestress load entry within the tendon key; 0 lets the program resolve/assign the serial from the LCNAME + GROUP_NAME combination.

LCNAME.description: Static load case name (must reference an existing static load case).

GROUP_NAME.description: Load group name; empty string means no load group.

TENDON_NAME.description: Tendon profile name to which the prestress load is applied.

TYPE.description: Value type of the prestress magnitude. STRESS applies a jacking stress, FORCE applies a jacking force. Case-insensitive.

ORDER.description: Jacking sequence / where jacking starts from: BEGIN, END, or BOTH ends. Case-insensitive.

BEGIN.description: Prestress value (stress if TYPE=STRESS, force if TYPE=FORCE) at the begin end of the tendon.

END.description: Prestress value (stress if TYPE=STRESS, force if TYPE=FORCE) at the end end of the tendon.

GROUTING.description: Grouting stage / construction stage step at which the tendon is grouted; 0 means no grouting stage assigned.
